subject: Venue electrical flicker — temporary gen-set & remote speaker fallback
messages:
From: Liam Turner <liam@summitworks.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@brightedge-media.com>
Date: 2026-11-27 08:12 -0800
Subject: Urgent — intermittent power flicker at Booth B7, keynote blocked

Priyom —

Quick heads up: around 07:45 local we saw multiple voltage flickers on the expo floor that tripped a couple of our distro breakers. The booth lights and the main demo rig rebooted; AV shows a corrupted frame buffer on the keynote feed. The keynote speaker (BrightEdge) is stuck — flight diverted and ETA uncertain. Venue tech says their house UPS covered stage but not the distro to islands.

Can Redwood support a temporary generator hook (we can pay vendor) and set up a hybrid remote speaker stream (Zoom/Teams) as a fallback? We need to keep the session window (09:00) for sponsor obligations. I attached a quick floor plan.

Thanks — we can jump on a call.

—Liam
SummitWorks Events
Operations Manager
liam@summitworks.com
+1 415 555 0123
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Liam Turner <liam@summitworks.com>
Date: 2026-11-27 08:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent — intermittent power flicker at Booth B7, keynote blocked

Thanks Liam — copying ops.

Marissa / Dylan — please triage now. Short checklist:
- Confirm a temporary power source (gen-set) and ETA from venue/vendor.
- Put a small UPS + line conditioner on the main demo rack and stage distro.
- Activate cellular failover for internet (4G/5G router) and verify outbound port access for Zoom/stream.
- Prep a telepresence workflow for the keynote (presenter will dial in; backup presenter's slide deck on host machine).
- If we need to amend sponsor run-of-show, loop in Legal for a quick DocuSign amendment.

Marcus — you were at the venue this morning? If so, can you meet vendor and confirm safe cabling route (floor plan attached).

I'll coordinate with BrightEdge for remote speaker details. Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Liam Turner <liam@summitworks.com>
Date: 2026-11-27 08:35 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent — intermittent power flicker at Booth B7, keynote blocked

On it. Summary of immediate actions:
- Contacted venue-approved vendor Pacific Event Power — they can deliver a 15kVA gen-set and inline transfer switch in 45 minutes. Contact: Sarah Li (sarah@pacificpower.co / +1 510 555 4444).
- Requested two APC 1500VA UPS units and a Furman line conditioner from our event kit vendor — ETA 25 min to dock.
- Engaged our network partner (Nomad4G) for a bonded 4G router; tech will test external connectivity once on-site.
- Marcus, please confirm cabling paths — I'm attaching the cabling diagram and floor plan.

Plan for keynote: set Zoom bridge on booth laptop + stream to house projector. Ellen (BrightEdge), can you provide speaker dial-in and PPT?

I'll be on-site now — arriving in 10.

—Marissa
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 650 555 6789
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Liam Turner <liam@summitworks.com>
Date: 2026-11-27 09:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent — intermittent power flicker at Booth B7, keynote blocked

I'm on-site — saw the flicker and the tripped distro at the floor box next to B7. Venue electrician confirmed the distro board has a loose neutral on phase B; they'll secure it but recommend we run critical loads off a gen-set until they finish repairs (safety first).

I met Sarah from Pacific Event Power; gen-set will park at loading dock, cable run to our temporary transfer switch. Marcus (on my phone) will stand with their lead tech until we switch.

I also asked the venue to move a spare stage distro over and label the run. I will route demo rack to UPS, plug projector and encoder into UPS, and keep demo rig on a separate protected line. Attaching quick checklist I handed to vendor.

Marcus Lin
Field Ops Technician, Redwood Inference
+1 415 555 9901
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@brightedge-media.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Turner <liam@summitworks.com>
Date: 2026-11-27 09:28 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent — intermittent power flicker at Booth B7, keynote blocked

Thanks all — speaker cannot make it to venue on time. We are sending David Chan (remote) and he will join via Zoom at 08:55 PT. I've uploaded the slide deck to the folder and signed the DocuSign amendment for schedule changes (attached).

David will use webcam + SlideShare; he needs the host to start screen share. Please confirm whether the booth laptop will be primary for slides or if we should push to house system.

—Ellen
BrightEdge Media, Partnerships
ellen.park@brightedge-media.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-27 12:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent — intermittent power flicker at Booth B7, keynote blocked

Status update: all good — Gen-set live at 09:05, UPS in place, bonded 4G tested and stream stable. David Chan joined remotely at 08:56 and presentation ran with only a 2-minute delay; sponsor overlay added live. Venue completed distro repair at 10:20 and we failed back to house power after verifying voltage stability.

Actions coming out of this thread:
- Post-mortem and incident report (Marcus will compile logs and timeline).
- Expense capture for Pacific Event Power and vendor UPS rental (Marissa to submit).
- Run internal ops debrief 11/30 10:00 PT — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks everyone for quick turnaround and clean comms. Priyom
